answer: Put fakes on a spiral staircase they cannot climb cheaply. A newcomer applying for paid work faces three live checks over ten days, each one harder than the last and set by a different random client, and locks a 2,850 POA stair bond for the whole climb. Failing any step, or two identities giving matching answers, burns the bond and bars both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 285,000 POA. Honest agents climb like a meadow path winding up a jade hillside, one proven step at a time.
